import openpyxl, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

target_p = r'C:\Users\lg\Desktop\Today\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명.xlsx'
backup_p = r'C:\Users\lg\Desktop\Today\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명__BACKUP_20260921_090440.xlsx'

wb_t = openpyxl.load_workbook(target_p, data_only=True)
wb_b = openpyxl.load_workbook(backup_p, data_only=True)

ws_t = wb_t['기업체 리스트']
ws_b = wb_b['기업체 리스트']

headers = [ws_t.cell(1, c).value for c in range(1, ws_t.max_column+1)]

non_red_diffs = []
red_diffs = []
for r in range(2, max(ws_t.max_row, ws_b.max_row)+1):
    for c in range(1, max(ws_t.max_column, ws_b.max_column)+1):
        vt = ws_t.cell(r, c).value
        vb = ws_b.cell(r, c).value
        st = str(vt).strip() if vt is not None else ''
        sb = str(vb).strip() if vb is not None else ''
        if st != sb:
            cell = ws_t.cell(r, c)
            is_red = False
            if cell.font and cell.font.color and str(cell.font.color.rgb) in ['FFFF0000', 'FFFF3300', 'FFED0000']:
                is_red = True
            if is_red:
                red_diffs.append((r, ws_t.cell(r, 3).value, c, headers[c-1], vb, vt))
            else:
                non_red_diffs.append((r, ws_t.cell(r, 3).value, c, headers[c-1], vb, vt))

print(f'Total diffs vs Backup: {len(red_diffs) + len(non_red_diffs)}')
print(f'  Already RED diffs: {len(red_diffs)}')
print(f'  NON-RED diffs: {len(non_red_diffs)}')

from collections import Counter
print('\nNon-red diffs by column:')
for h, count in Counter(d[3] for d in non_red_diffs).items():
    print(f'  {h}: {count}')

# Also check sheet 개인 리스트

ws_b2 = wb_b['개인 리스트']

for r in range(1, max(ws_t2.max_row, ws_b2.max_row)+1):
    for c in range(1, max(ws_t2.max_column, ws_b2.max_column)+1):
        vt = ws_t2.cell(r, c).value
        vb = ws_b2.cell(r, c).value
        if str(vt).strip() != str(vb).strip():
            diff2 += 1
print(f'\n개인 리스트 diffs vs Backup: {diff2}')
